neet_che_u06_t00_4.working: Deuterium scrambling into ammonia happens because forward and backward reactions continue at equal rates. Both statements are true and R explains A.

neet_che_u06_t00_5.working: A catalyst speeds forward and backward reactions equally, so the amount of product at equilibrium is unchanged and I is false. II correctly describes dynamic equilibrium.
